newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-INJURY RULES SAMMER OUT OF EUROPEAN CUP TIE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INJURY RULES SAMMER OUT OF EUROPEAN CUP TIE.

text.p: European player of the year Matthias Sammer had been ruled out of Borussia Dortmund's European Cup quarter-final first leg against Auxerre because of a bruised calf.

National team doctor Hans-Wilhelm Mueller-Wohlfahrt on Monday advised the inspirational libero to rest for 10 days. Sammer sustained the injury while playing for Germany in last week's friendly with Isreal in Tel Aviv.
Austrian Wolfgang Feiersinger looks set to deputise for Sammer, as he did in Saturday's 4-1 Bundesliga win over 1860 Munich.
